sloka: स तं द्विरदमारुह्य विरूपाक्षो महारथः।विनदन् भीमनिर्ह्रादं वानरानभ्यधावत ।। ६.९७.१५ ।।
transliteration: sa taṁ dviradamāruhya virūpākṣo mahārathaḥ।vinadan bhīmanirhrādaṁ vānarānabhyadhāvata ।। 6.97.15 ।।

translations.english: That great charioteer Virupaksha ascended the elephant, frightening like a lion, and rushed towards Vanaras roaring.
